rows.shows: Rotation makes refaire, sans se borner, fermé, biordre induit and D’autre part readable; the last capital is a broad C followed by the low omme group. The isolated p-shaped sign remains an uncertain abbreviation. The note breaks off after des.
The heading’s final shallow stroke is not securely separable as s; parties at the right clearly has a final descending s. No underline appears under this heading, Bord or Deux tronçons.
A tall left brace groups three written cases. The condition s≤t stands separately without parentheses, and L has a looped base. Both infinity signs in the third row have their written signs.
Only troisième is written below the empty-set symbol; there is no dans le in this final case.
Two small points occur after bords; le has one l-loop and a low e without final s. The complete sont is readable.
